hook: Julian Schrittwieser is an Austrian software engineer and AI researcher. He worked at Google DeepMind for years, where he was a key contributor to AlphaGo and AlphaGo Zero and the lead author of MuZero, a reinforcement learning algorithm that mastered Go, chess, shogi, and Atari games while learning its own model of each game's rules. He went on to work on AlphaTensor, AlphaDev, and AlphaCode, and later on AlphaProof, which reached silver-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. In 2025 he moved to Anthropic to continue AI research. He also writes a technical blog, at julian.ac, about AI progress and software engineering.
